digest.component_or_area: fsck and compact-all commands / ticket archival
propositions: fsck and compact-all walks visit every ticket directory on every run (O(all tickets ever created)), making routine scans slower as archived tickets accumulate; scoping to active-only by default would improve performance while preserving full-store audits via --include-archived override

archive operation currently writes only the ARCHIVED event and .archived marker without folding unfolded tail events, deferring the fold to a later compact-all walk; moving the terminal fold inline at archive time ensures no unfolded events are stranded in archived tickets
fsck and compact-all commands lack an --include-archived flag to opt into full-store walks, whereas ticket list already has this pattern with marker fast-path and net-archival confirmation
archived tickets with stale markers or reverted archives must still be visited by default fsck/compact-all (marker alone insufficient — net-archival event-name confirmation must decide)
legacy-archived tickets created before the terminal-fold change remain unfolded on disk; compact-all --include-archived must still fold them as a belt-and-suspenders path
